study: M8 dynamic Elo as independent pre-match information for Crown AH contract outcome prediction; research only

method.elo_system: league-specific Elo; initial 1500; K=20; 65-point home advantage in updates; win/draw/loss outcome update; no margin multiplier
method.elo_asof: only prior matches at least 2 UTC calendar days before target/receipt date; all same-day results are updated as a batch after features are assigned
method.reporting_timezone: Asia/Shanghai UTC+08:00; Elo information cutoff remains UTC with a two-calendar-day embargo
method.targets: five-state home AH contract settlement (full/half loss, push, half/full win)
method.models: CROWN_ONLY=line, no-vig home share, overround; ELO_CONTRACT=line, Elo rating difference/400; CROWN_PLUS_ELO=both feature sets
method.estimator: multinomial softmax with train-year-only standardization and fixed L2=1.0; no test-year parameter selection
method.walk_forward: for test year Y, model trained only on earlier years; one direction selected per match by higher predicted net U at actual Crown line and actual two-sided quote, with no EV threshold/no abstention
method.ev_selection: a separate non-production diagnostic abstains when both predicted sides have expected net payoff <= 0U; zero is the economic break-even point, not a deployed Gate
method.stake: 1U per selected match; quarter AH split into two half-stakes
method.historical_quote: Crown source-event T1 replay; not actual HTTP receipt or execution
method.actual_receipt_quote: latest valid actual pre-kick MR1 Crown receipt per FID, raw SHA and exact Crown asian_list line/odds rechecked; only verified FT rows evaluated

out_of_eight_week_bootstrap_2024_2026.method: ISO-week cluster resampling within calendar year; descriptive, exploratory; not adjusted for prior M8 model search

actual_receipt_audit.note: Archive results were observed before this research; this is retrospective receipt-price replay, not a blind or production-forward trial.

limitations: M8 input score source has no exact first-received timestamp; two-day event-time embargo reduces same-week information leakage but cannot prove historical score data were received at decision time.
Crown T1 paths were retrieved historically; their HTTP response was received in 2026, not at the historical event time.
The true receipt subset has only the matches with a separately verified FT index; this is retrospective and already appeared in prior M8 research.
Current-year 2026 T1 inventory is partial and source-file coverage definition differs from other user-provided 2026 inventory totals.
This is a single predefined Elo parameterization, but the broader M8 program has prior model-selection history; no independent blind validation is claimed.
